description: Tanques de tormentas is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Madrid. Storm tanks are wastewater storage tanks in rainy weather. When it rains there comes a time when the collected flow exceeds the treatment capacity of the treatment plants or the transport capacity of the sewerage network. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Madrid. The portal shows the English title as "Storm tanks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Madrid. Its keywords include agua. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, XLSX, PDF. The listing shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
